full_judgment: 3. The plaint case, in brief, are that the lands of SA Khatians 686 and 687 of mouja Khada, police station-Sharankhola within the district of Bagerhat originally belonged to Hatem Ali Hawlader, the predecessor of the plaintiff. After the death of Hatem Ali, the plaintiff and defendants 3-17 as heirs became its owner. The plaintiff purchased .2550 acres of land of SA Khatian 686 from defendant 10 through a registered kabala dated 06.08.1992. Thus he became a cosharer in the suit jote by way of inheritance and purchase. The plaintiff used to look after his land through his father-in-law. He went to his in-law’s house in the morning on 18.05.2007 and found defendants 1 and 2 moving around the suit land. On query, he came to learn that defendants 3-17 sold out the suit land to them at a consideration of Taka 6.10 lac. In presence of Abdul Hares Akand (PW2), Abdul Jabbar Talukder (PW3), Jamal Talukder and Abdul Kader Mollah of Kadamtala village, the plaintiff beat his chest and claimed the land; he offered defendants 1 and 2 to take the consideration money and hand over the land to him which they refused. The plaintiff then collecting certified copy of the disputed kabala instituted the instant suit for pre-emption under Muslim Law.
